task_title: Allow --local-image with --new-bundle-format for v2 and v3 signatures
problem_statement: Cosign can verify images saved locally with `cosign save`, but the local verification path does not properly support the new Sigstore bundle format. Right now `verify` and `verify-attestation` reject `--local-image` together with `--new-bundle-format`, and saved OCI layouts containing new-format referrer bundles are not handled the same way as remote images. Update local verification so a saved image can be verified from disk when it contains either legacy signatures/attestations or new-format Sigstore bundles.
problem_statement_variant: Saved OCI layouts are treated differently from remote images during verification. Cosign should be able to inspect a locally saved image directory, detect whether it contains legacy verification material or newer Sigstore bundles, and verify it correctly without forcing users away from `--new-bundle-format`.
hints: The key paths are `cmd/cosign/cli/options/verify.go`, `cmd/cosign/cli/verify/verify.go`, `cmd/cosign/cli/verify/verify_attestation.go`, and `pkg/cosign/verify.go`. The current issue shows up in the local-image flag handling and in the absence of a local equivalent to remote bundle discovery. Existing nearby coverage lives in `pkg/cosign/verify_oci_test.go` and `test/e2e_test.go`.
